GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. found plenty in Straight # too good

Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Four Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken Five Wide @ 500m. Struggling Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Found trouble @ 200m & gave ground in straight. # Wide & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced four wide-throughout. Rider dropped his whip passing the 250m. Passing 200m was badly crowded and had to be checked when it lost its running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went through on fence to lead. led turn. found plenty in Straight # too speedy
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. hooked Wide turn 5 lengths. Held Ground # pulled up lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider said his instructions were to be positive early and to ensure the gelding finishes off the race. He added the horse felt uncomfortable in its action and for this reason he did not ride the horse with his usual vigour. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be lame in its off-hind leg (grade 2/5).Trainer was advised that a veterinary clearance would be required prior to being permitted to race again.  VC received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 3 Wide 1 length. 3 Wide turn under pressure. weakened # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide throughout and over-raced in the early and middle stages. Laid in in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. kept pressure on leader. shared lead turn 6 lengths in front of 3rd. got to front 200 metres. grabbed late # poor ride
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated he was instructed to ride his mount positively and if circumstances permitted to obtain the lead. He added that when runners to his inside showed intent to lead, he had to make some use of his mount to settle outside the leade which was pulling hard to his inside. He added that near the 800m his mount also commenced to overrace and despite his initial efforts, he was unable to have it settle until approaching the 600m where he was obliged to allow his mount to stride rather than continue to fight it.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 6 lengths. Wide turn under pressure. weakened # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride his mount 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy. Began awkwardly and shifted in. Raced three-wide throughout.
Rider was permitted to ride the gelding 1/2kg overweight in accordance with the policy. Slow to begin and soon after made contact with the hindquarter of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. looking for run turn 3 lengths. not much room in Straight . ran on well in restricted room # forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. got to outside turn under pressure 2 lengths. battled on well # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After the 1000m when racing keenly, had to be restrained from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 4th, 3 Lengths @ 800m. Hooked Out wider all Clear Straightening Up . Kept Going Soundly in Straight but couldn't quicken as required. winner led # sound/had chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. hooked 3 Wide turn 1 length. weakened. Every Chance # pulled up lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned stated his mount was on one reign and inclined to lay in throughout. He added that his mount hung in in the home straight and proved difficult to ride out. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be lame (grade 2/5) in the off-hind. Trainer was told that he would have to provide a veterinary clearance prior to the gelding racing or trialling again. Vet cert received.
